prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landing page hero illustration for a local security developer tool. Style/medium: tactile ink, graphite, paper collage and subtle risograph grain; handmade, precise, mature, not cute. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, main specimen on the right two-thirds with quiet paper space on the left for adjacent web copy; slight imperfect rotation, overhead view. Lighting/mood: soft natural desk light, calm forensic confidence. Color palette: warm paper #F4EEDC, near-black ink #1D2523, pine #245C4A, oxide red #A63D2F. Constraints: no people, no hands, no logos, no readable words, no legible text, no UI screenshot, no gradients, no neon, no padlock cliché, no watermark. Any log notation should be abstract short strokes and braces only; redaction bars must be fully opaque.
